snippet.title: Silpheed - DOS MT32 + Soundblaster
snippet.description: This is just quick session of me playing a special release version of Silpheed that supported the Sound Blaster for sound effects with the MT-32 being used for music. Love the music in this game though I'm not very good at playing it as can be seen in the video. The sound effects are also a bit too much volume wise and that is why you sometimes only hear the music for a bit during this game play session.
